title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1991-09-13
source: This is a matrix of these sources: SBD: shnid=31244 (DSBD > DAT > CD > EAC > FLAC) // DAUD: shnid=97387 (B&K 4011 110 degrees ORTF > Neumann BS 48i-2> Modified Sony TCD D-10 Pro)

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording of a solid 1991 MSG show, highlighting Jerry’s evolving guitar work and consistently strong crowd‑favorite performances.
ai_review.review: The two reviewers praise this September 1991 Madison Square Garden concert as a reliably good set, noting Jerry Garcia’s transitional yet confident playing and the overall tightness of the band. The matrix source blends board clarity with audience ambience, delivering a clear listening experience without reported flaws. While no specific songs are singled out, the show is described as full of well‑played crowd favorites.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high marks (5 and 4 stars) and emphasized strong musical performance and a good matrix recording; limited detail yields medium confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix blend of soundboard and audience provides clear, balanced sound with lively ambience; no issues were reported by reviewers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the concert as a solid, unremarkable run with consistent energy and smooth transitions, marking a period of Jerry's musical transition.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Highlighted as being in a transitional phase but playing confidently and redefining his style.
